01-keep-awake.eyebrow: 轻巧的菜单栏防休眠工具
headline: 一键开启
保持电脑唤醒
description: 防止空闲休眠，从容应对
下载、渲染与 Agent 长任务。

也能防止系统空闲休眠。

自动结束防休眠

本次防休眠随即结束。
唤醒后保持关闭，按需再次开启。
03-manual-sleep.interaction: 唤醒后，按需再次点击咖啡杯开启
03-manual-sleep.footnote: 不必额外惦记关闭防休眠

headline: 小巧常驻
简单就够了
description: 保持系统唤醒，按需保持屏幕常亮。

04-simple.interaction: 右键展开菜单，核心控制一目了然

05-open-source.eyebrow: 一个开放、透明的小工具
headline: 源码公开
透明可查
description: 采用 MIT 开源许可，
可查看源码，也可自行构建。
05-open-source.interaction: 核心实现公开，可查看与自行构建

01-keep-awake.eyebrow: A lightweight menu bar sleep blocker
headline: One click.
Stay awake.
description: Prevent idle sleep during downloads,
rendering, and long-running agent tasks.
01-keep-awake.interaction: Click the cup to turn it on or off.

02-display-sleep.eyebrow: Separate controls for system and display
headline: Screen off.
System awake.
description: Keep the system awake without
keeping your display on.
02-display-sleep.interaction: Uncheck this option to allow display sleep.
02-display-sleep.footnote: Display sleep follows your system settings.

03-manual-sleep.eyebrow: Your choice to sleep ends the session
headline: You choose Sleep.
Awake mode ends.
description: When you put your computer to sleep,
the current stay-awake session ends.
After waking, it stays off until you enable it.
03-manual-sleep.interaction: After waking, click the cup when you need it.
03-manual-sleep.footnote: One less thing to remember to turn off.

04-simple.eyebrow: A small utility that lives in your menu bar
headline: Small. Simple.
Just enough.
description: Prevent idle sleep. Keep the screen on
when needed. Two controls, one menu.
04-simple.interaction: Right-click the cup to see both controls.
04-simple.footnote: Focused on keeping your computer awake.

05-open-source.eyebrow: A small utility, open for inspection
headline: Open source.
See how it works.
description: MIT licensed. Read the source code,
or build the app yourself.
05-open-source.interaction: Explore the code or build it yourself.
05-open-source.sceneCaption: An excerpt from the actual source

01-keep-awake.eyebrow: メニューバーの小さなスリープ防止ツール
headline: ワンクリックで

description: ダウンロード、レンダリング、

04-simple.eyebrow: メニューバーに常駐する小さなツール

05-open-source.eyebrow: 中身を確認できる、オープンなツール
